# First Week With Claude

A practical, independent 7-day coding sprint for new builders.

This independent site helps new coders use Claude for a focused 7-day coding sprint. It includes a referral CTA, beginner guide, reference manual, prompt library, FAQ, pricing notes, and official-source links.

Important: This site is not affiliated with Anthropic. Referral/free-week offers are controlled by Claude/Anthropic and must be verified on the official signup page.

- /claude-code-for-beginners.html
- /reference-manual.html
